title: Source
description: A retrieved source chunk with relevance score.

collection.description: The registry collection id this source came from. Present only on a multi-collection request (`collections`, issue #253) — a single-collection request's response is unchanged.

symbol_glossary.description: The chunk's symbol glossary (#754): one `<symbol> — <definition>` line per symbol the chunk uses, copied from its own document at ingest; never part of `content`. Present on EVERY source if and only if the /v1/retrieve request set `include_symbol_glossary: true`, and then "" when the chunk has none (or the lookup was unavailable) — so an absent key means "not requested", an empty string means "none". Absent otherwise, so a request without the flag gets a response byte-identical to before the field existed.

context.description: Neighbouring chunks of the same document, attached only when the request set context_window > 0 and at least one neighbour is visible; absent otherwise. Ordered by position (negative = before the source, positive = after). A neighbour that is itself a returned source is omitted here rather than duplicated.

position.description: Offset from the source in chunks: -1 is the immediately preceding chunk, 1 the following one.
